story.iWant: to register existing private GitHub repos as brownfield Party projects on EC2, with one-way sync from GitHub → EC2 controlled by an explicit Refresh action
story.soThat: I can initiate BMAD party-mode debates against my real codebases (debatator, applicator, songster, futurator) from mobile, anywhere, while continuing to commit and push from my laptop as the single source of truth

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
AC #1 — PartyProject is extended with `kind: 'greenfield' | 'brownfield'` (discriminator), optional gitRepoUrl, gitBranch (default 'main'), lastPulledAt, lastCommitSha. Existing rows lazy-migrate to kind='greenfield' on first read.
AC #2 — POST /api/party/projects with `{ name, kind: 'brownfield', gitRepoUrl, gitBranch? }`: gitRepoUrl matches `^https://github\.com/[\w.-]+/[\w.-]+(\.git)?$`; name kebab-cased to projectId (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$); gitBranch defaults to 'main'. On success the row is created with kind='brownfield', bmadStatus='INSTALLING', and a party-bootstrap job is enqueued with payload.kind='brownfield'. Greenfield path unchanged.
AC #3 — On brownfield bootstrap, the pipeline runs ONLY: (a) clone-repo (`git clone --branch <gitBranch> --depth 50 <tokenized-url> <projectPath>`), (b) verify (assert bmad/_cfg/agent-manifest.csv exists with ≥1 row), (c) compute-sha (reuse custom-agents-sha.mjs; empty bmad/agents/ acceptable), (d) persist (HEALTHY, bmadVersion, agentCount, lastPulledAt=now, lastCommitSha). Steps refresh-source, install (npx bmad-method), sync-agents are SKIPPED. Events emitted via the existing observability spine.
AC #4 — Brownfield PAT loaded once at daemon startup from AWS Secrets Manager secret `futurator/labs-brownfield-github-pat` (fine-grained, contents:read scope, restricted to the 4 target repos). PAT never logged, never written to any DDB row, never in event payloads. Tokenized clone URL `https://x-access-token:<token>@github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git` constructed in-memory; raw token redacted to `https://***@github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git` in captured stdout/stderr/event output via the new daemon/pipelines/lib/git-clone.mjs helper. Redaction unit test required.
AC #5 — Brownfield clone without bmad/_cfg/agent-manifest.csv at verify-time: bmadStatus='FAILED', failureReason='BMAD_NOT_FOUND_IN_REPO', no auto-retry, event party.bootstrap.failed emitted with reason field.
AC #6 — New endpoint POST /api/party/projects/:id/refresh (auth-gated). Greenfield → 400 INVALID_FOR_GREENFIELD. Brownfield → enqueue party-refresh job; daemon runs `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/<gitBranch>`, recomputes customAgentsSHA, re-verifies, persists lastPulledAt + lastCommitSha; emits party.refresh.completed with new SHA.
AC #7 — Refresh while same project's refresh job is PROCESSING → 409 REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS. Refresh while any session for the project has status='PROCESSING' → 409 PROJECT_BUSY. Lock is conditional UpdateCommand on the project row transitioning `bmadStatus IN ('HEALTHY','DRIFTED') → 'REFRESHING'`; session-busy check queries futurator-party-sessions GSI1 (PK=projectId) filtering status='PROCESSING'.
AC #8 — Admin UI: "Add Brownfield Project" button in Labs Party page header opens a 3-field modal (name, gitRepoUrl, gitBranch default 'main') with inline regex validation. On submit calls POST /api/party/projects with the brownfield shape, closes modal, invalidates ['party','projects']. Brownfield cards display Git Lucide icon, middle-truncated gitRepoUrl (>40 chars), branch chip, lastPulledAt as relative time, and a Refresh secondary action (replacing Re-inspect for brownfield). While the refresh job is PROCESSING the button shows a spinning state and the card badge displays REFRESHING.
AC #9 — First turn of a brownfield party session uses /bmad-party-mode slash command unchanged. Agents read the cloned repo via Claude Code's native Read/Glob/Grep under existing --permission-mode acceptEdits. Per [[brownfield-party-permission-mode]] memory NO path-scoped restrictions are added; incidental edits are wiped by `git reset --hard` on next refresh. BMAD-workflow artifacts land at <projectPath>/docs/ per each repo's own bmad/bmm/config.yaml:output_folder; retrievable via existing GET /api/party/projects/:id/files unchanged.
AC #10 — Mobile UX parity at ≤768px: modal form visually correct, brownfield card layout reflows (Git+URL one row, branch chip + lastPulledAt next row, action buttons full-width). Playwright smoke test tests/e2e/party.smoke.spec.ts includes a viewport-768 assertion that the modal renders all three input fields without horizontal scroll.
AC #11 — Visible obligations reminder on each brownfield card: small muted text near lastPulledAt reading "Push first, then Refresh — EC2 mirrors GitHub". No automation; operator owns the commit/push/refresh loop. Documented in CLAUDE.md under a new "Labs Party — Brownfield Usage" section.
AC #12 — All new and extended unit tests pass: party-projects-repository.test.ts (brownfield row, lazy migration, refresh-lock paths, updateProjectAfterRefresh); party-schema.test.ts (BrownfieldProjectInputSchema positive + negative); party-bootstrap.test.mjs (brownfield clone-success, missing-BMAD failure, secret redaction); party-refresh.test.mjs (NEW — fetch+reset, refresh-lock conflict, busy-session, brownfield-only gate, git error paths); git-clone.test.mjs (NEW — URL tokenization, redaction filter, non-zero-exit).
AC #13 — `npm run ci` passes end-to-end with zero lint warnings, passing typecheck, all tests, successful build. Manual EC2 verification: register debatator, applicator, songster, and futurator; each clones to its own PROJECTS_ROOT folder; each transitions to bmadStatus='HEALTHY'; tap Refresh on each → lastPulledAt and lastCommitSha update; start a session on each → agents read codebase and respond in multi-voice.

doc.title: Epic 15 — Labs Party Mode
doc.section: Story 15.4 — Brownfield Party Project Bootstrap & Refresh
doc.snippet: Canonical scope, ACs, prerequisites, and tech-notes for the brownfield extension. Adds 3 story points to a 13-pt epic for a total of 16 pts.

doc.title: Party Module Tech Spec
doc.snippet: Greenfield 8-step pipeline (validate, refresh-source, bmad-install, sync-agents, rebuild-manifest, compute-sha, verify, persist). The brownfield branch parallels this but executes only 4 steps (clone, verify, compute-sha, persist).

doc.title: Party Module Tech Spec
doc.snippet: Inspector verifies bmad/_cfg/manifest.yaml exists, parses bmad/_cfg/agent-manifest.csv, recomputes customAgentsSHA. Brownfield verify step reuses the same checks.

doc.title: Party Module Tech Spec
doc.snippet: Conditional-update lock pattern used by tryAcquireBootstrapLock. The new tryAcquireRefreshLock mirrors it with the HEALTHY|DRIFTED → REFRESHING transition.

doc.title: Story 15.1 — BMAD per-project install & inspection
doc.snippet: RFC-4180 CSV-escaping behavior on agent-manifest.csv read (re-encountered in brownfield verify). Establishes the @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb and child_process mock patterns reused by the new tests.

doc.title: Story 15.2 — Party session orchestration & turn loop
doc.snippet: Turn 1: /bmad-party-mode + session-id. Subsequent turns: --resume <claudeSessionId>. Brownfield sessions reuse this verbatim — no changes.

doc.title: Story 15.3 — Labs Party UI
doc.snippet: Frontend foundation: project-list.tsx, project-status-badge.tsx, session-chat.tsx, hooks under src/hooks/use-party-*, party-store.ts. Add Brownfield button is gated by Ec2Toggle (hidden when mode !== 'ec2'). The Playwright auth-pre-seeded session pattern is the basis for the new viewport-768 test.

doc.title: BMAD BMM module config
doc.snippet: output_folder: '{project-root}/docs' — canonical BMAD artifact path. Each cloned brownfield repo carries its own bmad/bmm/config.yaml; debate-spawned BMAD workflows write into <projectPath>/docs/ accordingly.

doc.title: Project guidance for Claude Code
doc.snippet: To be added in this story per AC #11: registration steps, the "Push first, then Refresh — EC2 mirrors GitHub" obligations contract, the four current target repos, deferred concerns (no Memgraph ingestion, no daemon push). Existing DEPLOY SAFETY rules remain unchanged.

doc.title: User memory — brownfield party candidates
doc.snippet: The four target repos (debatator, applicator, songster, futurator) and the rationale for the batch (real codebases, mobile-accessible debates, dogfooding). One-way sync: laptop pushes to GitHub → EC2 pulls via git fetch && git reset --hard. Daemon never pushes.

story-context.constraints: - Brownfield is an EXTENSION of PartyProject, not a new entity. NO new DDB tables, S3 buckets, or event spines. Reuse the existing party.bootstrap.*/party.refresh.* observability spine. [Source: docs/epics-party-module.md Story 15.4; tech-spec-party-module.md §Bootstrap Pipeline Steps] - Single source of truth = the operator's laptop's GitHub repo. EC2 mirrors GitHub via clone/refresh. The daemon NEVER writes back to GitHub. Incidental edits agents make during debates are wiped by `git reset --hard` on the next refresh. The obligations contract ("Push first, then Refresh — EC2 mirrors GitHub") is social, not technical. [Source: party-mode debate session 2026-05-16/17; CLAUDE.md per AC #11; memory project_brownfield_party_candidates.md] - Permission posture unchanged from greenfield: `claude -p --permission-mode acceptEdits`. NO path-scoped Edit/Write restrictions — investigation confirmed they require settings.json + PreToolUse hooks (not a single CLI flag), which fails the "must be simple" bar. [Source: memory feedback_brownfield_party_permission_mode.md] - BMAD ships WITH the cloned repo. Brownfield bootstrap SKIPS `npx bmad-method install` and the custom-agent sync from bmad-agents-source. If a debate needs a specific custom agent, the operator commits it into the upstream repo's bmad/agents/ — no admin-side push. [Source: party-mode debate session 2026-05-16/17] - Artifacts land at <projectPath>/docs/ per each repo's own bmad/bmm/config.yaml:output_folder. Retrievable via the existing GET /api/party/projects/:id/files endpoint with NO modifications. [Source: bmad/bmm/config.yaml:18] - Refresh lock = conditional UpdateCommand mirroring the existing tryAcquireBootstrapLock pattern. Session-busy check = query on futurator-party-sessions GSI1. [Source: party-projects-repository.ts:108-152] - All zod validation via .safeParse() only — never .parse() at the route boundary. Errors raised as ValidationError. [Source: CLAUDE.md "Validation" + Story 15.1 patterns] - Secrets (PAT) never logged, never written to any DDB row, never in event payloads. Redact `https://x-access-token:<token>@...` → `https://***@...` in all captured stdout/stderr/event output. [Source: AC #4 + ops practice] - DynamoDB multi-table convention — extend the existing futurator-party-projects table; do NOT introduce a separate brownfield-projects table. [Source: memory feedback_dynamodb_multi_table; CLAUDE.md] - API_BASE_URL stays relative in production (empty string + `/api`); NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL only for local dev. [Source: CLAUDE.md "Key Conventions"] - `npm run ci` must pass with zero warnings: `eslint --max-warnings 0`, format:check, knip, typecheck, test, build. [Source: package.json:20] - Daemon runs on EC2; the daemon's IAM role needs secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on the new BrownfieldGithubPat ARN. The API Lambda role does NOT need access to this secret (the Lambda only enqueues jobs; the daemon does the cloning). [Source: AC #4] - One-way sync only — daemon never `git push`. Drift back to GitHub is the operator's responsibility (laptop → GitHub via `git push`). [Source: memory project_brownfield_party_candidates.md] - Re-running brownfield bootstrap on a HEALTHY project (manual reinstall trigger) re-clones into the same path; existing on-disk content is replaced by the fresh clone. (Behavior parity with greenfield re-install at the user-facing level; investigate if existing folder needs explicit removal before clone — initial spike acceptable.)

interface.name: POST /api/party/projects
POST /api/party/projects/:id/refresh
interface.signature: Path: :id — projectId, validated via projectIdSchema Request body: empty Response 202: { jobId: string } Errors: 400 INVALID_FOR_GREENFIELD — project.kind === 'greenfield' 404 NotFoundError — project does not exist 409 PROJECT_BUSY — a session for this project has status='PROCESSING' 409 REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS — another refresh holds the lock
interface.path: functions/api/index.ts (NEW route, adjacent to bootstrap route)

interface.name: partyProjectsRepo.tryAcquireRefreshLock
interface.signature:
(projectId: string) => Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; reason: 'REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS' | 'NOT_FOUND' | 'INVALID_STATE' }>
Behavior: conditional UpdateCommand. ConditionExpression: attribute_exists(projectId) AND bmadStatus IN (:healthy, :drifted) On success: SET bmadStatus=:refreshing, updatedAt=:now On ConditionalCheckFailedException: re-fetch row and disambiguate (NOT_FOUND vs REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS vs INVALID_STATE for non-healthy/non-drifted states).

interface.name: partyProjectsRepo.releaseRefreshLock
interface.signature:
(projectId: string, newStatus: 'HEALTHY' | 'FAILED') => Promise<void>
UpdateCommand SET bmadStatus = :next, updatedAt = :now

interface.name: partyProjectsRepo.updateProjectAfterRefresh
interface.signature:
(projectId: string, patch: { lastPulledAt: string; lastCommitSha: string; customAgentsSHA: string; agentCount?: number }) => Promise<void>
Typed wrapper over updateProjectState. Caller is the daemon party-refresh pipeline.

interface.name: cloneRepo
interface.signature:
cloneRepo({ repoUrl: string, // https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>(.git)? branch: string, // e.g. 'main' token: string, // raw PAT — used in-memory only targetPath: string, // <PROJECTS_ROOT>/<projectId> depth?: number, // default 50 ctx: { emit: Function } // for piping redacted output as events }): Promise<void>
Builds tokenized URL internally as `https://x-access-token:${token}@github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git`. Spawns `git clone --branch ${branch} --depth ${depth} <tokenized-url> ${targetPath}`. Captures stdout/stderr; redacts the raw token (and the tokenized URL form) before passing to ctx.emit or logger. Throws Error with redacted message on non-zero exit.

interface.name: runPartyRefresh
selectHandler / validatePartyRefreshJob (extension)
useCreateBrownfieldProjectMutation
interface.signature:
() => UseMutationResult<{ jobId: string; projectId: string }, Error, { name: string; gitRepoUrl: string; gitBranch?: string }>
Calls api.post('/party/projects', { name, kind: 'brownfield', gitRepoUrl, gitBranch }). On success: queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['party', 'projects'] }).

interface.name: useRefreshProjectMutation
interface.signature:
() => UseMutationResult<{ jobId: string }, Error, string /* projectId */>
Calls api.post(`/party/projects/${projectId}/refresh`, {}). On success: polls /agent-jobs/:jobId/events at 1500ms via existing event-poll pattern; invalidates ['party','projects'] on terminal event party.refresh.completed / .failed.

interface.name: BrownfieldProjectInputSchema (zod)
interface.signature:
z.object({ name: z.string().min(1).max(64).regex(/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/), kind: z.literal('brownfield'), gitRepoUrl: z.string().regex(/^https:\/\/github\.com\/[\w.-]+\/[\w.-]+(\.git)?$/), gitBranch: z.string().min(1).max(120).regex(/^[^\s]+$/).default('main'), })
Combined with the existing greenfield input via z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [...]).

tests.standards: Vitest jsdom environment with @/ alias and tests/setup.ts shared setup. Coverage includes src/** and functions/**. Repository tests use @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb DocumentClient mocks established in Story 15.1's party-projects-repository.test.ts; daemon pipeline tests use vitest's vi.mock on child_process.spawn (see existing party-bootstrap.test.mjs and party-turn.test.mjs for the pattern). ideas.idea: Repository test — putting a brownfield row sets kind='brownfield' on read; reading a row with no kind attribute returns kind='greenfield' (lazy migration) without writing back.

Schema test — BrownfieldProjectInputSchema accepts a valid HTTPS GitHub URL (with and without `.git`), rejects SSH `git@github.com:...`, rejects non-github hosts, rejects empty name, rejects names violating the kebab-case regex, rejects branch strings containing whitespace; default `gitBranch='main'` applied when omitted.
API test — POST /api/party/projects with a brownfield body enqueues a job whose `partyBootstrapPayload.kind === 'brownfield'`; greenfield body path is unchanged.

Daemon test — brownfield bootstrap success path runs exactly 4 steps (clone-repo, verify, compute-sha, persist) and emits party.bootstrap.completed; greenfield path still runs the full 8-step pipeline.

Git-clone helper test — given repoUrl + raw token, the helper spawns git with a URL containing the token (assert via spawn-arg capture); captured stdout/stderr passed to ctx.emit never contains the raw token; the redacted form `https://***@github.com/...` is what appears in events.

Daemon-startup test — if Secrets Manager throws (secret missing or AccessDenied), daemon logs and continues; greenfield bootstrap jobs continue to succeed; brownfield jobs fail fast with a clear "PAT not loaded" error.

Daemon test — brownfield clone-success but verify finds no bmad/_cfg/agent-manifest.csv → bmadStatus='FAILED', failureReason='BMAD_NOT_FOUND_IN_REPO', no retry, party.bootstrap.failed emitted with reason field set.

Repository test — tryAcquireRefreshLock from HEALTHY succeeds; from DRIFTED succeeds; from INSTALLING/REFRESHING/FAILED fails with appropriate reason (uses conditional UpdateCommand). releaseRefreshLock(projectId, 'HEALTHY' | 'FAILED') sets the next state.

Daemon test — runPartyRefresh success path: git fetch + reset stub succeeds, SHA recomputed, verify passes, HEAD SHA read, updateProjectAfterRefresh called with the new lastPulledAt + lastCommitSha + customAgentsSHA, lock released to HEALTHY, party.refresh.completed emitted.
Daemon test — runPartyRefresh failure path on git failure (e.g., network error mocked): lock released to FAILED, party.refresh.failed emitted, no partial mutation persisted.

API test — POST refresh on greenfield → 400 INVALID_FOR_GREENFIELD. POST refresh while a session is PROCESSING → 409 PROJECT_BUSY. POST refresh while another refresh holds the lock → 409 REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS.
Component test (vitest jsdom) — AddBrownfieldForm renders 3 inputs; submit button disabled until all 3 validate; valid submit calls the mutation with the right payload shape; close button cancels.

Component test — project-list.tsx given a brownfield project renders the Git icon, truncated URL, branch chip, lastPulledAt relative time, the obligations hint string, and the Refresh action (not Re-inspect).
Playwright — viewport={width:768,height:1024}: open the Add Brownfield modal; assert all 3 input fields are visible without horizontal scroll; submit-button is present and tappable.
Smoke test — every brownfield card includes the literal text "Push first, then Refresh — EC2 mirrors GitHub" (or a stable substring) near lastPulledAt.

Job-router test — selectHandler({ jobType: 'party-refresh' }) returns JOB_HANDLER_PARTY_REFRESH. validatePartyRefreshJob rejects missing payload / missing projectId / missing gitBranch with clear reasons.

CI gate — `npm run ci` exits 0 with no eslint warnings (--max-warnings 0), knip clean, typecheck clean, all tests pass, build succeeds. Document the EC2 manual-verification command sequence in daemon/README.md or a story-internal note.
